fact: The NIA Executive Director said 17.8 million Ghanaians were registered on the National Identification Register, about 51 percent of the 35.1 million population (share computed here, the document gives no share).

National Identification Authority data as at 30 October 2026, reported by Dubawa, show 20,610,948 people enrolled for the Ghana Card, against a Ghana Statistical Service population projection of 34,378,768 for 2026 and a 2021 census count of 30,832,019.
The National Identification Authority has registered over 18 million Ghanaians, per Interior Minister Muntaka at the mid-2025 review; the document gives no population figure.
